newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks in London mostly unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks in London mostly unchanged.

text.p: Japanese stocks in London were mostly unchanged in quiet trade on Wednesday, dealers said.
The Nikkei/ISE 50 index nudged up 0.98 points to 1,614.93 by 1415 GMT, after the Nikkei 225 index in Tokyo broke the 20,000 barrier for the first time since May 28.
"It's extremely quiet," said one dealer. "No one wants to be the first to dip their toes in the water."
Sony Corporation was one of the few features in London. Its shares gained 10 yen to 9780 yen after a weak performance in Tokyo.
